title: Symphony cloud request v1
description: Body of POST /v1/requests. The tenant is never sent: it comes from the device certificate and user token.

request_id.description: Unique per user for 24 hours. A retry with the same ID is rejected (409) so tools never run twice.

conversation_id.description: Stable for one conversation; the same value continues the agent session.

data_tier.description: Ceiling chosen by the Jetson router. local-only is always refused by the cloud.

deadline_ms.description: How long the agent may work before the request ends.

model_preference.description: step-up selects the frontier model and requires data_tier frontier-eligible.

messages.description: Conversation turns, oldest first; the last one is the user's new message.
